yoke.config.title: Yoke
yoke.config.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Point this at your own server; defaults to the hosted DeepSeek API. Resolved on the machine Yoke runs on — in a remote window that is the remote host, so set it in Remote settings when the endpoint is reached differently from there.
yoke.config.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens per request. Set to 0 to use the API default (no limit). Useful for controlling costs.
yoke.config.experimental.stabilizeToolLi:
**Experimental**: improve your endpoint's prompt-cache hit rate by pre-activating available tools.
- When the enabled tools list changes across turns, this may improve the cache hit rate.
- Requests will include more function definitions, so input tokens may increase. Cache-hit input tokens are usually billed at a lower price, but still count toward usage.
- This may add internal preflight tool calls to the current Copilot chat history. If you switch to another model in the same conversation, that model provider may reject or mishandle the replayed history. Start a new chat if model switching behaves unexpectedly.

Use [Configure Tools](command:workbench.action.chat.configureTools) to **view and manage** your tool list:

- 64 or fewer enabled tools: usually no need to enable this unless the tool list still changes across turns.
- More than 128 enabled tools: not recommended. The DeepSeek API accepts at most 128 functions in one `tools` request and many self-hosted servers cap it lower. Consider disabling tools you rarely use.
yoke.config.debugMode.description:
Controls what diagnostic information Yoke writes. Token usage is always reported to Copilot regardless of this setting.

- **Minimal** — Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or request dumps.
- **Metadata** — Privacy-safe diagnostic metadata (request hashes, prefix overlap, tool schema changes). Does not contain prompt text — safe to share in public issue reports. View with [`Yoke: Show Logs`](command:yoke.showLogs).
- **Verbose** — Complete request payloads written to disk for local debugging. **Warning: contains sensitive prompt content.** View with [`Yoke: Open Request Dumps Folder`](command:yoke.openRequestDumpsFolder).
yoke.config.debugMode.minimal.label: Minimal
yoke.config.debugMode.minimal.descriptio: Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or dumps.
yoke.config.debugMode.metadata.label: Metadata
yoke.config.debugMode.metadata.descripti: Privacy-safe metadata. Safe to share publicly. View with `Yoke: Show Logs`.
yoke.config.debugMode.verbose.label: Verbose
yoke.config.debugMode.verbose.descriptio: ⚠️ Contains sensitive prompt content. For local debugging only.
yoke.config.modelIdOverrides.description: Override the API model ID sent for the three **built-in** DeepSeek cloud models. Leave empty unless a compatible third-party API serves them under different names. Self-hosted models declare their own `id` in `customModels` and are unaffected by this setting.
yoke.config.modelIdOverrides.deepseek-v4: API model ID for DeepSeek V4 Flash
API model ID for DeepSeek V4 Pro
API model ID for DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp
yoke.config.customModels.description: Models to expose instead of the built-in DeepSeek cloud models. Use this for a self-hosted or OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Each entry declares its own `id` (sent verbatim to the API), context window, and capabilities. A self-hosted server usually shares one budget between prompt and completion, so `maxInputTokens` should be the server's limit minus `maxOutputTokens`. Leave empty to use the built-in models.
yoke.config.visionModel.description: Vision Proxy used by models without native image input. When unset, auto mode selects the built-in DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp if available. Configure a different VS Code model or API endpoint with [Configure Vision Proxy](command:yoke.setVisionModel).
yoke.config.visionPrompt.description:
Prompt the Vision Proxy uses to describe image attachments. It does not affect models that accept images natively.

[Configure Vision Proxy](command:yoke.setVisionModel)
yoke.config.requestTimeoutMs.description: How long a request may go without receiving any data, in milliseconds, before it is abandoned. Set to `0` to wait indefinitely. A self-hosted server can spend many minutes prefilling a long conversation before it returns its first byte, so this defaults to 15 minutes rather than the 5-minute limit Node imposes on `fetch`. Raise it if long agent sessions are cut short.
yoke.config.registryUrl.description: URL of a model registry that lists the endpoints you run, for example `http://127.0.0.1:8899/registry`. When set and reachable, its models replace `customModels`, so a fleet is described in one place instead of being copied into every machine. The registry is never waited on: if it is unreachable, the last models it returned are reused, and `customModels` remains the fallback beneath it. Leave empty to configure models by hand. Like `baseUrl`, it is resolved on the machine Yoke runs on.
